flows.title: Upload a video
steps: In the top-right corner, click CREATE, then Upload videos.
Select the file you would like to upload. You can upload up to 15 videos at a time.
Click Edit on each file to edit your video details on the Details tab.
If you close the upload window before you finish choosing your Visibility settings, the video is saved as private on your Content page in YouTube Studio.

flows.title: Set the channel's audience
steps: On the left menu, click Settings.

Under Audience, select Yes if you mostly upload content made for kids, No if you almost never upload content made for kids, or I want to review this setting for every video to set it video by video. The page states this is legally required, so it describes what the channel publishes rather than a preference.
